String.string:
[EN] Ghost and Crystal
[ES] Ghost y Crystal
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Put the journal away.
[ES] Guarda el diario.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Read the journal.
[ES] Lee el diario.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go back to the camp.
[ES] Regresa al campamento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather some fleabanes for the treatment.
[ES] Reúne algunas hierbas carniceras para el tratamiento.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] There's something odd about the Pile of Stones. Inspect it.
[ES] Hay algo extraño en la pila de piedras. Insplecciónala.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with the ghost.
[ES] Habla con el fantasma.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Direction the Ghost Pointed
[ES] Dirección que señaló el fantasma
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Straight to the Isolation Camp..."
[ES] "Directo al Campamento de Aislamiento..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go in the direction the ghost pointed.
[ES] Ve en la dirección que señaló el fantasma.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the fleabane to Ryshan and show him the journal.
[ES] Entrega la hierba carnicera a Ryshan y muéstrale el diario.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Take Ryshan's medicine.
[ES] Toma la medicina de Ryshan.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It tastes awful. No wonder Ameldas didn't want to drink it.
[ES] Sabe horrible. Con razón Ameldas no quería tomarla.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Glad to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Ryshan again.
[ES] Habla con Ryshan de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You feel stiff and itchy.
[ES] Te sientes rígido y con picazón.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
